description: Curated subset (100 newborn concepts: 50 dev, 50 held-out) of the OpenAlex concept-diffusion frame used by method.py H2 next-field entry analysis. g = per-concept grounded work counts [28 years 1995-2022, 27 slots: slot 0 = no venue field, slot k = OpenAlex field 10+k]. backbone = frozen iteration-1 26-field PMI relatedness (phi) + gateway centralities. GF = all-works counts per [year, field]. reference_full_run = headline numbers from the full 653-concept run.
